ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; left lobe exhibits a dominant high-intensity (white/light grey) macro-region (~65% area), while the right lobe presents a low-intensity (black) base overlaid with high-intensity (white) punctate distributions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: large contiguous light-grey region centered at mid-lobe, bordered by a low-intensity vertical band adjacent to the notch. Right lobe: high-density stochastic distribution of white 'salt-and-pepper' mottling across the entire visible surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle approximately 42 degrees with a vertical depth exceeding 25% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; irregular peaks and valleys concentrated along the upper trailing margins of both lobes, particularly prominent on the left lobe with local peak heights of 10-15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a sigmoid curve (concave near the notch, transitioning to convex at the mid-point). Right lobe displays a predominantly linear trajectory with a slight distal taper toward the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, roughly circular high-intensity pixel groups (2-8 pixel diameter) localized heavily on the inner right lobe and scattered across the central left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct, high-intensity diagonal linear disruption approximately 40 pixels in length located in the lower-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-relief, dark-to-light textured cluster at the distal tip of the left lobe, indicating significant epibiotic colonization (barnacles).
other_distinctive_markers: Pronest low-intensity (black) vertical band or 'pillar' separating the light pigment of the left lobe from the medial notch.
